coordinate_convention: Original image pixels, origin top-left; Blender metres, Z up, -Y front
notes: Landmarks are manually interpreted from artwork, not anatomical ground truth; joint positions under armor are estimates.
The front and back use a slightly different stance; the profile arm is bent and overlaps the torso. Do not distort one mesh merely to fit every visible arm contour.
The head close-up uses perspective and is not an orthographic fourth view. Use it for facial planes and hair flow, not exact full-body dimensions.
Front establishes proportions and panel borders; profile establishes depth; back establishes rear layout. These views are not guaranteed to be a physically consistent scan.
